blocks.x: JOSEPH VERNON "BIG JOE" TURNER JAZZ ORAL HISTORY TRANSCRIPTION
This is May 8th, and we're on Reel Three of the Oral History with Joe Turner.
Ah, Joe, let's go back to Kansas City for a minute, and we never got the names of your mother and father. Would you tell me their names, please.
Well, my daddy's name was Joe Turner. I'm Joe Turner, Jr.. My mother's name was Georgia Turner.
And what was her name before she got married?
And we lived in Kansas City, Missouri.
